title: Spot the difference: train station
prompt: Three things changed between the two train station pictures. Which list names all three changes?
explanation: Compare the two pictures bit by bit: The gray owl changed colour from brown to gray, the yellow ball vanished and the green book vanished. Nothing else is different.
